data.credibility: Sun Pharmaceutical shows high reliability on major guidance items like top-line growth, R&D spend, and product milestones, successfully maintaining or delivering them. However, they occasionally drop long-term pipeline topics like GL0034 without ongoing updates.

lines.line: Promised UNLOXCYT U.S. launch in second half of FY 26 and delivered.
Promised ILUMYA psoriatic arthritis sBLA filing in second half of FY 26 and delivered.
Promised GL0034 Phase-2b study in 12 to 18 months, but topic was dropped.
Guided high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27, currently on track.
Guided FY27 R&D spend at 6% to 7% of sales, currently on track.
Guided Organon acquisition completion in Q4 FY27, currently on track.
